notes: Variant names describe the artwork; no pressed/disabled behavior is assigned.
Input controls are binding hints only; no input or skill behavior is installed.
Punctuation glyphs depend on keyboard layout. Unmapped symbols have an empty inputControls array.
LCK is generic lock lettering; degree-hyphen is named from its visible marks, not assigned to a physical key.
Up/Dwn text keys are grouped with Insert/Delete/Home/End and mapped to PageUp/PageDown; arrow icons map to arrow keys.
Each output retains its complete 16x16 source cell and transparent margins.
